technical.summary: RCL shows short-term bullish momentum with EMA golden cross and price above key moving averages, but overbought oscillators and weak ADX trend strength limit conviction; entry risk is elevated near resistance without volume confirmation.

fundamental.summary: RCL shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 16 days—fundamental signals are absent across all smart money indicators.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (24 score) presents contrarian opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior member over past 5 months provides minimal conviction support.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (327), strong dollar pressures multinational cruise operator, and earnings binary event in 16 days compounds volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA golden cross and Ichimoku cloud breakout provide short-term momentum confirmation with extreme fear sentiment creating contrarian opportunity near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators, weak ADX trend confirmation, negative CMF, absent volume support, imminent earnings binary event, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: EMA golden cross and Ichimoku breakout offer short-term momentum, but entry occurs near resistance with overbought oscillators and zero volume confirmation—risk-reward is unfavorable.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 16 days combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and strong dollar headwinds create unacceptable volatility risk for swing trade timing.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
